2608.01462.title: Loud or Silent? A Reusable Framework for Per-Modality Failure Analysis in Multimodal Clinical AI
2608.01462.paper_summary: Multimodal clinical models are usually judged on accuracy with every modality present, but deployment removes modalities; an echocardiogram is often unavailable where an ECG is routine. Two questions then matter beyond the size of the accuracy loss: which modality was responsible, and whether the model fails loudly or silently once that modality is dropped. The distinction is per-example and modality-level, and is separate from post-hoc feature attribution (e.g. SHAP). Models are replaced often; the evaluation that answers these questions is reused. We present a model-agnostic modality-failure framework: given N modality embeddings, any mask-aware probe, and labels, it returns a per-example failure taxonomy, a per-modality complementarity matrix that attributes error to modalities, and a loud-vs-silent dropout profile separating monitorable failures from those that pass unflagged far from the decision boundary, using only deployment-observable signals. We release it as a small, unit-tested harness and validate it against planted ground truth. Across seeds it recovers that planted modality dominance and complementary subset, reports per-modality loud-vs-silent rates, and scales to a three-modality complementarity matrix; because the planted structure is known by construction, this validates recovery of per-example attribution rather than clinical performance. We then instantiate the framework on frozen EchoJEPA and HuBERT-ECG embeddings for LVEF and the EF <= 40% HFrEF gate over a paired MIMIC-IV cohort, where on the held-out test split (n = 245) dropping echo nearly doubles error. The narrow echo-to-ECG overlap that bounds cohort size is itself a deployment finding for cardiac foundation models. All of our work can be found at https://github.com/criticaldata/PRIMED-AI.
2608.01462.paper_summary_zh: 多模態臨床模型通常在所有模態存在時以準確性來評價，但在部署時會移除模態；在常規使用心電圖的地方，超聲心動圖往往無法獲得。那麼，除了準確性損失的大小之外，還有兩個問題很重要：哪一種模態是負責的，以及一旦該模態被移除，模型是會大聲失敗還是靜默失敗。這一區分是基於每個示例和模態的，並且與事後特徵歸因（例如 SHAP）是不同的。模型經常被替換；回答這些問題的評估會被重複使用。我們提出了一個模型無關的模態失敗框架：給定 N 個模態嵌入、任何掩碼感知探針和標籤，它返回每個示例的失敗分類、歸因於模態的每個模態互補矩陣，以及一個大聲與靜默的掉出輪廓，將可監控的失敗與那些在決策邊界遠處未被標記的失敗分開，僅使用可觀察到的部署信號。我們將其作為一個小型、單元測試的工具釋出，並對其進行了植入的真相驗證。在不同的隨機種子上，它恢復了植入的模態主導性和互補子集，報告每個模態的大聲與靜默比率，並擴展到三個模態的互補矩陣；因為植入結構是已知的，這驗證了每個示例的歸因恢復，而不是臨床表現。然後，我們在凍結的 EchoJEPA 和 HuBERT-ECG 嵌入上實現該框架，以 LVEF 和 EF <= 40% HFrEF 門檻針對配對的 MIMIC-IV 隊列，在保留的測試分割（n = 245）中，移除超聲幾乎將錯誤翻倍。限制隊列大小的狹窄超聲與心電圖的重疊本身就是心臟基礎模型的部署發現。我們的所有工作可以在 https://github.com/criticaldata/PRIMED-AI 找到。
